user.title: Add a panel device
user.description: Name the device, for example Kitchen Kindle.

pairing.title: Pair the device
pairing.description:
Copy these two values into the Kindle's `config` file (`url=` and `token=`).

url: `{url}`

token: `{passphrase}`

{url_note}

init.title: Regenerate passphrase
init.description: Submit to create a new passphrase. The old one stops working immediately.

done.title: New passphrase
done.description: Copy this into the Kindle's `config` file (`token=`): `{passphrase}`
